comment: Recognition layer 2: community/district signs. Coordinates are real OSM lat/lon, projected into world space via road.project() at load. radius = trigger distance in compressed-world meters. Entries marked needs_owner_review should be verified against the owner's lived knowledge — map data alone is unreliable for small communities.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: Narrow spit of land linking the airport to Kingston; sea on both sides

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: First community on the Kingston side of the Palisadoes strip

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: East Kingston industrial and residential area near the old fort
